performance.method: Synthetic 14 complexes × 4 drones, 512 m square, 1 m cells, manual 68 m²/complex, dt=1s. Ten warm steps, 300 measured. The old-v9 control runs use the identical snapshot on archived base_commit and current code. Fresh compact geometry changes routes; do not interpret its factor as equivalent-work optimization.

limitations: Clear-sky horizontal solar model and explicit 0.8 factor, not a weather guarantee.
Stationary deployed duty assumption; deployment/relocation costs occur in the live simulation.
Relative carrier positions are fixed during operations and group relocation; no free repacking of old saves.
New core carriers need free reserved hub mounts; a full service block rejects further growth without moving existing equipment.
Real DEM is imported separately, never substituted over user terrain by the energy preset.
Linux/Qt offscreen tested; Windows CI not run for unpushed local commits.
